verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe pasting an existing MCP URL with 'No deploy required' for connecting to Manufact, plus generated hosted MCP URLs per deployment/branch that clients can point to directly, and one-click/copy-paste client configuration for Cursor, VS Code, etc. This directly matches the story of reaching downstream tools via a hosted URL without deploying infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that a purely 'connect existing server' or hosted-URL flow works end-to-end without any dashboard/CLI setup friction.
